query: Equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr has 8–16% room-temperature tensile ductility in the cast state and a yield strength of 163–530 MPa at 1000 °C at strain rates of 10−4–10−2 s−1, but its poor oxygen resistance limits practical high-temperature use. What single intervention could overcome this limitation without sacrificing the alloy’s useful mechanical performance? Formulate one hypothesis specifying the intervention and mechanism, the predicted change relative to untreated cast HfNbTaTiZr, the relevant temperature, atmosphere, exposure time, and mechanical-loading boundaries, supporting prior evidence, and a controlled falsification experiment.

generation.hypothesis: The addition of 1 at.% Aluminum (Al) to Equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr will improve its oxidation resistance at high temperatures without sacrificing its mechanical performance.
generation.intervention: Addition of 1 at.% Aluminum (Al) to the alloy composition
generation.conditions: Temperature: 1000 °C, Atmosphere: Air, Exposure time: 100 hours, Mechanical-loading boundaries: Strain rates of 10−4–10−2 s−1
generation.structural_mediator: Formation of a protective alumina (Al2O3) layer on the surface
generation.mechanism: The added Aluminum reacts with oxygen to form a thin, adherent Al2O3 layer, which acts as a barrier to further oxidation and reduces the oxidation rate of the underlying alloy
generation.predicted_outcome: A 50% reduction in oxidation rate (mg/cm²/h) and a 10% increase in yield strength (MPa) at 1000 °C, relative to untreated cast HfNbTaTiZr
generation.boundary: Oxidation rate < 0.1 mg/cm²/h, Yield strength > 150 MPa at 1000 °C
generation.uncertainty: The actual oxidation resistance and mechanical performance may vary depending on the specific processing conditions and microstructure of the alloy

falsification_experiment.design: Controlled oxidation test in air at 1000 °C for 100 hours, followed by tensile testing at 1000 °C
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the oxidation rate is not reduced by at least 30% or the yield strength is not increased by at least 5% relative to untreated cast HfNbTaTiZr, the hypothesis is falsified
